Description.SourceString:
No honour amongst thieves they say - not even my own brothers! We could’ve carried out double the take if Ferchar hadn’t insisted on bringing that ugly fabric with us. The chest would’ve been easier to carry with all four of us. Now, we’re left with nothing. Floated away with the desert sands? Likely story. I could’ve sworn that ugly rug was on the other side of the fire when we turned in, but one of them must have moved it. One of them must have buried our fortune in the night. Perhaps they’re all in on it. Rob the youngest of his share, as always!

Let the three of them chase each other across the Burning Spire if they wish. I’m staying right here, where we made camp. Whoever buried our prize must return eventually, and when they do, I'll be waiting. My waterskin may be empty, but my wits remain. Chase your own tails, brothers. I’ll have no part in it.
